title: GATE Mechanical Engineering
description: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering for Mechanical Engineering — a national-level exam for admission to M.Tech, PSU recruitment, and UPSC ESE. Conducted by IITs on rotation. Total 65 questions, 100 marks, 3 hours.
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering (final year or passed)

title: GATE Civil Engineering
description: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering for Civil Engineering — covers structural, geotechnical, hydraulics, transportation, and environmental engineering. Key exam for M.Tech admissions and PSU recruitment.
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering (final year or passed)

title: GATE Computer Science & IT
description: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering for Computer Science and Information Technology — one of the highest-appearing GATE papers. Key for M.Tech admissions, PSU IT roles (BARC, DRDO, BSNL), and software-sector research programmes.
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Sc (CS/IT/Mathematics) — final year or passed

title: GATE Electrical Engineering
description: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering for Electrical Engineering — covers circuits, machines, power systems, control systems, and signals. Critical for power-sector PSUs (BHEL, NTPC, PGCIL) and M.Tech admissions.
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical Engineering or related (final year or passed)

title: GATE Electronics & Communication Engineering
description: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering for Electronics and Communication — covers analog/digital circuits, communications, signals, VLSI, and electromagnetics. Important for ISRO, DRDO, BEL, and M.Tech in VLSI/Communications.
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E. in Electronics, ECE, EEE, Instrumentation (final year or passed)

title: GATE Chemical Engineering
description: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering for Chemical Engineering — covers thermodynamics, transport phenomena, reaction engineering, and process control. Key for ONGC, IOCL, BPCL PSU roles and M.Tech/MS admissions.
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E. in Chemical Engineering or related (final year or passed)

title: GATE Aerospace Engineering
description: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering for Aerospace Engineering — covers aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, and flight mechanics. Key for ISRO, DRDO, HAL, and M.Tech in Aerospace / Aeronautical programmes.
eligibility: B.Tech / B.E. in Aerospace, Aeronautical, or Avionics Engineering (final year or passed)

title: GATE Biotechnology
description: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering for Biotechnology — covers microbiology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioprocess engineering, and bioinformatics. Relevant for DBT, CSIR labs, and pharma-sector research roles.
eligibility: B.Tech in Biotechnology / Biomedical / Biochemical Engineering, or B.Sc / M.Sc Life Sciences (final year or passed)

title: JEE Main
description: Joint Entrance Examination (Main) — gateway to NITs, IIITs, and other CFTIs. Also the qualifying exam for JEE Advanced (IIT admission). Conducted by NTA twice a year. Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics — 90 questions, 300 marks.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with PCM subjects, minimum 75% aggregate
syllabus: Physics: Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Optics, Modern Physics
Mathematics: Algebra, Calculus, Coordinate Geometry, Trigonometry

title: JEE Advanced
description: The gateway to IITs — India's most competitive engineering entrance examination. Only the top ~2.5 lakh JEE Main scorers are eligible. Tests deep conceptual understanding and problem-solving ability in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.
eligibility: Top 2.5 lakh JEE Main qualified candidates; Class 12 pass, first or second attempt

title: UPSC Engineering Services (Mechanical)
description: Union Public Service Commission Engineering Services Examination for Mechanical Engineering — one of the most prestigious government engineering exams in India. Leads to Class-1 gazetted officer posts in Central Government departments.
eligibility: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, age 21–30 years

title: IIT JAM Physics
description: IIT Joint Admission Test for M.Sc Physics — the primary route from B.Sc to M.Sc at IITs and IISc. Covers Classical Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Quantum Mechanics, Statistical Mechanics, and Mathematical Methods.
eligibility: B.Sc Physics (final year or passed), minimum 55% aggregate

title: IIT JAM Mathematics
description: IIT Joint Admission Test for M.Sc Mathematics — gateway to IIT and IISc M.Sc / PhD programmes in Mathematics. Covers Real Analysis, Linear Algebra, Abstract Algebra, Calculus, and ODE/PDE.
eligibility: B.Sc / B.A. Mathematics (final year or passed), minimum 55% aggregate

title: IIT JAM Chemistry
description: IIT Joint Admission Test for M.Sc Chemistry — route from B.Sc Chemistry to M.Sc at IITs. Covers Physical, Organic, and Inorganic Chemistry comprehensively.
eligibility: B.Sc Chemistry (final year or passed), minimum 55% aggregate
syllabus: Physical Chemistry: Quantum, Thermodynamics, Kinetics, Electrochemistry
Inorganic Chemistry: Coordination, Organometallic, Main Group

title: CUET UG
description: Common University Entrance Test (Undergraduate) — the single gateway for UG admissions to all Central Universities, many State Universities, and deemed universities. Conducted by NTA. Covers domain-specific subjects, language, and general aptitude.
eligibility: Class 12 pass or appearing — all streams
syllabus: Section II: Domain Subjects (27 subjects — Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, Economics, Accountancy, Business Studies, History, Geography, Political Science, Psychology, etc.)
Section III: General Test (Quantitative, Logical Reasoning, GK)

title: CA Foundation
description: Chartered Accountancy Foundation level — first step of the ICAI CA programme. Covers Accounting Principles, Business Laws, Quantitative Aptitude, and Business Economics. Can be attempted after Class 12.
conductingBody: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
eligibility: Class 12 pass or appearing (registered for 4 months before attempt)
syllabus: Paper 4: Business Economics & Business & Commercial Knowledge

title: UGC NET Commerce
description: University Grants Commission National Eligibility Test for Commerce — qualifies candidates for Assistant Professor posts and Junior Research Fellowship in Commerce at Indian universities.
conductingBody: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of UGC

title: UGC NET Economics
description: University Grants Commission National Eligibility Test for Economics — qualifies for Assistant Professor and JRF in Economics. Covers Micro/Macro Economics, Statistics, Development Economics, and International Trade.
conductingBody: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of UGC

title: NEET UG
description: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate) — the sole entrance for MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, and other medical/dental/ayush undergraduate programmes in India. Conducted by NTA. Physics, Chemistry, Biology — 180 questions, 720 marks.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with PCB, minimum 50% aggregate (40% for reserved categories)
